mapper.sql: app.application_id, app.receipt_no, app.announcement_id, a.title AS announcement_title, app.company_user_id, u.company_name, u.business_no, app.project_name, app.total_budget, app.request_grant, app.self_funding, app.summary, app.plan_atch_file_id, f.ORIGNL_FILE_NM AS plan_file_name, app.status, c.CODE_NM AS status_name, app.submitted_at, app.created_at, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(e.total_score), 1) FROM evaluation e WHERE e.application_id = app.application_id AND e.status = 'COMPLETED') AS avg_score

FROM application app INNER JOIN announcement a ON app.announcement_id = a.announcement_id INNER JOIN users u ON app.company_user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE c ON c.CODE_ID = 'DPM002' AND c.CODE = app.status LEFT JOIN COMTNFILEDETAIL f ON f.ATCH_FILE_ID = app.plan_atch_file_id AND f.FILE_SN = 0

where.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM evaluation ev WHERE ev.application_id = app.application_id AND ev.evaluator_user_id = #{evaluatorUserId})
AND (app.project_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR u.company_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR app.receipt_no = #{searchKeyword})

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM application app INNER JOIN users u ON app.company_user_id = u.user_id
SELECT application_id, announcement_id, company_user_id, request_grant, status, receipt_no, plan_atch_file_id FROM application WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE application SET project_name = #{projectName}, total_budget = #{totalBudget}, request_grant = #{requestGrant}, self_funding = #{selfFunding}, summary = #{summary}, plan_atch_file_id = #{planAtchFileId}, updated_by = #{audit.userId}, updated_at = #{audit.now} WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND status = 'TEMP_SAVED'

UPDATE application SET project_name = #{projectName}, total_budget = #{totalBudget}, request_grant = #{requestGrant}, self_funding = #{selfFunding}, summary = #{summary}, plan_atch_file_id = #{planAtchFileId}, receipt_no = #{receiptNo}, status = 'SUBMITTED', submitted_at = #{audit.now}, updated_by = #{audit.userId}, updated_at = #{audit.now} WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND status = 'TEMP_SAVED'
UPDATE application SET status = 'TEMP_SAVED', submitted_at = NULL, updated_by = #{audit.userId}, updated_at = #{audit.now} WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND status = 'SUBMITTED'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM application WHERE status <> 'TEMP_SAVED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM application WHERE status = 'SELECTED'
